rationale: The stock gapped down ~17% on a significant earnings miss (EPS -36%, revenue -22%) and is now consolidating in the lower third of today's range, below both VWAP ($17.39) and the 9-EMA ($17.40), suggesting continued selling pressure. However, the last five 1-minute candles show very low volume and tight, directionless price action ($17.34–$17.40), offering no clear momentum signal in either direction. With the price pinned below key intraday references and no catalyst for a reversal, the risk/reward for either a short (already extended from the gap) or a long (no demand evidence) is insufficient to justify a new position.
